verification.implementation: classification create/update/delete and knowledge+SWF delete transaction implemented

classification_response_contract: Classification add/list return exactly the TheoryKnowledgeClassifyVO fields id,type,name,createTime. create_id is still written to the database but is not an exposed VO field. classification-create-update covers the frontend blank-id create/edit/list/filter/remove flow.
classification_update_contract: Only absent/null/empty id creates a classification. A supplied id (including numeric JSON coerced to text like Jackson) must exist under a primary-key row lock before type/name are updated; otherwise HTTP200/code202 with message and description 未查询到该分类, with no insert. classification-create-update covers blank-id add, edit, stale string/numeric and deleted ids, listPageClassify/getBasicTheory filters, remove, and post-rejection state.
known_boundary: Full knowledge save/SWF/test nested snapshot parity and dedicated MySQL behavioral fixture remain required.
